[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Spice it up uses 2 new crafting stations obtainable via Heart event with Gus to turn your Crops, Forageables and even some minerals into Seasonings. Then take your freshly cooked Farmer's lunch or other Cooking items and add a little spice to add and increase their effects for the farmer when eaten.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Download, Extract and move the extracted "Spice It Up" folder to your Mods folder in Stardew Valley[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Items crafted with the new Spice Grinder will be turned into Seasonings. Seasonings will add new effects or enhance existing ones on Cooking Category Items when combined at the Food Prep Station.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]To obtain the Crafting Stations you must achieve 4 hearts with Gus and wait for a letter in the mail. Then they will be available in his shop.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Independent mod using only SMAPI[/size][/color]
